data.title: Calcium dobesilate
data.category: More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous systemic drugs
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous systemic drugs_

**Class:** Vasoprotective (angioprotective) agent

## Mechanism of action
- Reduces capillary permeability and fragility, improves blood viscosity and lymphatic drainage; inhibits VEGF and FGF signalling (anti-angiogenic) — also studied topically in rosacea

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Chronic venous insufficiency, stasis dermatitis (adjunct), haemorrhoids, diabetic retinopathy (Europe)
- Pigmented purpuric dermatoses (limited evidence)

## Dose & formulations
- 500 mg two to three times daily

## Adverse effects
- GI upset, skin rash, arthralgia
- Agranulocytosis (rare but serious) — stop if fever, sore throat

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity; history of agranulocytosis

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid (limited data).

## Viva points
- Venotonic for capillary fragility; agranulocytosis is rare but important

_Sources: Khopkar (Calcium dobesilate). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
